title: How should capacity be balanced when two track-roller quenching routes share one tempering furnace?
summary: Suneng's May 2026 track-roller heat-treatment line proposal for Jining Wuchuang Machinery Co., Ltd. specifies two heating furnaces, two automatic quenching machines and one tempering furnace. One route uses a turning mechanism before joining tempering feed. Review discharge and quenching on each route, then receiving after the merge. The opening “preferably 2 minutes” and individual-machine “4 minutes per piece” are not one confirmed cycle.
